script: AddBarEvent pj_projetBarEvent1 "Approach the displeased-looking merchant" "A merchant wearing a suit wears a rather troubled expression on their face." highlight

text:
They seem engrossed in something on their Tripad, but the moment your presence is noticed their head perks up.

"Ah, how fortunate. Captain, I hope?" You give an affirmative nod. "I'm in dire need of credits. For 2 million credits you can have my prototype modular ship control system, deal?"

You suspect this person is out of their mind

"Fantastic!" They seem rather enthusiastic about your apparent indifference.

After transferring 2 million credits, they shove a device in your hand, then quickly excuse themselves from the table. "My apologies, I have to go for an important arrangement now."

"Farewell, good luck, etc cetera!" The merchant waves from over their shoulder as they leave. They don't seem very good with conversation.
You see the device has "Projet" written on it. You decide to install it on your ship system.
"Wait, come back! Oh, come on." The merchant grumbles to themselves and shakes their head, muttering something about 'good instincts.'
